meta.title: National Payment Grid Under Ransomware Pressure
meta.summary: A major payment switch degraded by ransomware. Boardroom decision-making focused on national impact.

questions.text: What public posture should leadership take in the first hour?

answers.label: Issue a controlled early holding statement
answers.description: Acknowledge disruption and commit to regular updates.
answers.boardReading: Steadies the narrative and reduces rumor risk.
answers.consequence: Public trust is protected, but media cycle accelerates.

answers.label: Stay silent until technical certainty is higher
answers.description: Delay communication until impact is better understood.
answers.boardReading: Protects accuracy but risks being seen as indecisive.
answers.consequence: Forensic clarity improves, but trust falls if discovered early.
